description: This source file defines the Opencart.Admin.Controller.User.UserPermission class, which manages user permission operations such as listing permissions, editing, and form handling within the admin panel of an OpenCart-based e-commerce system. The class includes methods for displaying permission lists, handling form submissions for editing permissions, and loading related data and views.

classes.name: UserPermission
classes.description: Controller class for managing user permissions, including listing, editing, and form handling for user groups and permissions within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the list of user groups and permissions with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of user groups as a view, with optional sorting.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the list of user groups, including sorting, filtering, and pagination controls.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the listing of user groups with associated data and pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a user group permission.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve and prepare the list of user groups with sorting and filtering.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of user group permissions, processing POST data, permissions validation, creating or updating user groups, and returning JSON responses.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected user groups, with permission validation and JSON response.
